address: Boringdon Hall Hotel, Boringdon Hill, Plymouth, Devon,PL7 4DP
bio: Spoil yourself to an afternoon of luxury at the five star Boringdon Hall Hotel. Enjoy a sumptuous Afternoon Tea at this magical venue named after the Saxon phrase meaning 'enchanted place on the hill'.  Afternoon Tea is served in the The Great Hall or Mayflower Brasserie, providing quintessentially grand surroundings to indulge in the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea.  Boringdon's Afternoon Tea menu features a classic interpretation of the British ritual with a range of savoury treats, scones and sumptuous sweet delights. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to add a glass of Champagne. Special edition themed tiers are also available throughout the year for guests to enjoy.  Boringdon Hall is situated on the edge of the idyliic Dartmoor National Park, just 10 minutes from the city of Plymouth.  .
